stories.about: Ken Paxton, former Texas attorney general, faces Democrat James Talarico, a state representative, in what has emerged as an unusually competitive race for a Senate seat in a reliably Republican state, according to AP. Paxton won the Republican primary after surviving his 2023 impeachment and acquittal, while Talarico has sought to consolidate support from moderate and independent voters.

Israel holds legislative elections for the 25th Knesset, with incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu facing his most competitive challenge yet from opposition leader Gadi Eizenkot, according to the Times of Israel. Government formation following the vote will determine who is formally invested as Prime Minister, a process that can take weeks after results are announced.
